ext_description.message: An instrument, not a blocker. Shows which script read which fingerprinting surface, and parses outgoing beacons field by field.

btn_record_erase.message: Erase the previous recording and start

hint_reload.message: Recording starts by reloading the tab: the wrappers have to be in place before the page’s first script.

hint_no_permission.message: Permission was not granted — there is nothing to record with.

hint_stopped.message: Recording stopped everywhere. Wrappers already in place in open pages will go away when those pages reload: they cannot be removed from here, they live in the page’s own world.

hint_erase.message: The previous recording holds $1. Reloading the tab erases them — save the report first if you need it. Click again to start over.

scope_text.message: Fingerprinting surfaces and outgoing traffic — from two independent sources: the wrappers inside the page, and the network. Where they disagree is the evasion detector.

scope_parsers.message: Format parsing is wired up for GA4, Meta Pixel, Yandex.Metrica and Webvisor. For every other address the body is shown as-is, labelled “format not identified” — which is not the same as “no fields”. Font fingerprinting through offsetWidth is deliberately not covered.

attr_via_extension_deeper.message: another extension ($1), further down the stack $2

health_empty.message: Recording is on, no observations yet.

health_reconcile.message: Source reconciliation: $1 confirmed by both, $2 went past the instrumentation, $3 never reached the network, $4 cannot be checked (WebSocket), $5 outside observation — styles, scripts, fonts, images. They are counted but not listed: there is nothing to accuse them of, and as a list they would drown the beacons.

health_time_note.message: Time is shown only for calls with a stack capture — those can be measured. Counted calls cost less than the measurement itself, so their time is not shown.

health_killswitch.message: The instrument reduced detail so as not to disturb the page. Further calls are counted without being attributed to a script.

health_budget.message: The detail budget is spent. Further calls are counted but not attributed to a script: a stack capture costs about 25 µs, and without a ceiling the instrument would visibly slow the page down.

health_shadowed.message: Wrapper shadowed on the instance: $1. Someone — almost certainly another extension — put an own property on top of ours, so these surfaces are not observed even though they are wrapped. Checked only for objects that exist as a single instance: for canvas and WebGL contexts this cannot be known in advance (limit 3b).

health_wrap_failed.message: Could not wrap: $1. The instrument is blind on these surfaces.

health_truncated.message: The journal was truncated at its size ceiling. Some observations were not kept.

coverage_why.message: There are deliberately no entropy bits here: they do not exist without a distribution across all users, and this instrument runs on one machine. Any such number would be trust in someone else’s dataset, not a measurement.

egress_order_note.message: . Evasions first, then requests with a body, then the rest.

verdict_network_only.message: network saw it, wrappers did not

source_network_only.message: source not determined — observed from the network only

installed_row.message: instrument in place at $1 ms — wrapped: $2

filter_note.message: A filter is on: showing $1 of $2. The rest did not vanish — you hid it, and all of it still goes into the export.

confirm_raw_export.message:
Save WITHOUT redaction?

The file will contain your real device and session identifiers, your user id, hashes of your email and phone, the previous page address and raw request bodies.

A file like this must not be attached to bug reports or forwarded.

OK — without redaction. Cancel — with redaction.

export_saved.message: Saved. Values stripped: $1. The fields themselves are still visible.

export_saved_raw.message: Saved WITHOUT redaction; the filename says so. The checkbox is now cleared — the next export is redacted again.

limit_internal.message: Observation from inside the page is marked internal: the channel is visible to the page. Only a match against the network — which the page cannot forge — raises it to confirmed.

limit_wrappers_visible.message: The page can see the wrappers and the delivery channel.

limit_workers.message: Workers are not observed. A fingerprint taken inside a worker is invisible to the instrument; only a beacon from it shows up, and only through the network. A call from a freshly created frame, by contrast, is visible: the instrument gets in there too.

limit_other_extensions.message: Other extensions in your browser replace the same APIs. Their calls are marked “not the site”. Whether an extension acts on its own or at the page’s request is something the instrument cannot tell.

limit_websocket.message: WebSocket is not checked against the network: permissions do not cover the ws scheme. That is not the same as “the request did not go out”.

limit_parsers.message: Format parsing exists for GA4, Meta Pixel, Metrica and Webvisor. For other addresses the label “format not identified” does not mean “no fields”.

limit_in_stacks.message: The instrument shows up in other people’s stacks. Browser errors and warnings may point at instrument/main.js: the wrapper sits in the call chain, so its frame lands in the trace. Being in the stack does not make it the cause — before blaming it, reproduce without it.

limit_unknown_source.message: When a stack cannot be parsed we write “source not determined” rather than putting the page there.

fact_gpu_model.message: The site learned your GPU model

fact_gpu_vendor.message: The site learned your GPU vendor

fact_timezone.message: The site learned your time zone

fact_cores.message: The site learned how many cores your processor has

fact_memory.message: The site learned how much RAM you have

fact_os.message: The site learned your operating system

fact_screen.message: The site learned your screen size

fact_ua_hints.message: The site asked for the exact platform model and browser versions

fact_ua_hints_note.message: These are high-entropy User-Agent hints: they narrow down the set of machines more than usual

fact_canvas.message: The site took an image fingerprint through canvas

fact_canvas_pixels.message: The site read pixels off a canvas directly

fact_audio.message: The site took an audio fingerprint

fact_fonts.message: The site enumerated the fonts installed on your machine

fact_webrtc.message: The site asked for your local network address through WebRTC

fact_devices.message: The site asked for the list of your cameras and microphones

fact_voices.message: The site asked for the list of speech synthesis voices

fact_voices_note.message: The set of voices depends heavily on the system and therefore distinguishes machines well

fact_cookie_id.message: The site set a long-lived identifier in a cookie

fact_storage.message: The site wrote data into browser storage

fact_worker.message: The site started a background worker

fact_worker_note.message: What happens inside a worker is invisible to the instrument — limit 4

fact_webvisor.message: The site is recording what you do on the page

fact_webvisor_note.message: Mouse movement, scrolling, clicks and typing into fields. The recording can later be played back as video. What exactly ended up in it is invisible to the instrument

fact_other_extension.message: Your data was read not only by the site but by another extension in the browser

fact_other_extension_note.message: Whether the extension acts on its own or at the page’s request is something the instrument cannot tell. These calls are not counted against the site.

fact_evasion.message: The network saw requests the wrappers did not

fact_evasion_note.message: This is what an evasion looks like, and also a preload the browser starts on its own from a hint in the markup, and a request from a worker. The instrument cannot say who sent them or why — only that they happened

fact_unattributed.message: A further $1 could not be attributed to a source

fact_out_device_id_note.message: It ties your separate visits together

fact_out_user_id.message: Your user id on the site went to $1

fact_out_user_id_note.message: This ties the visit to your account, not just to your browser

fact_out_email.message: A hash of your email address went to $1

fact_out_email_note.message: The hash cannot be reversed, but it is the same on every site and therefore links them

fact_out_phone.message: A hash of your phone number went to $1

fact_out_personal.message: Hashes of your personal data went to $1

fact_out_personal_note.message: Gender, date of birth, city, postcode — individually they mean little, together they identify a person

fact_out_referrer.message: Where you came to this page from went to $1

fact_out_page_url.message: The address of the page you are looking at went to $1

report_warning.message: THIS FILE WAS SAVED WITHOUT REDACTION. It contains real device and session identifiers, the user id, hashes of email and phone, the previous page address and raw request bodies. Do not attach it to bug reports and do not forward it.

report_redacted_kinds.message: device and session identifiers, the user id, hashes of email, phone and name, the previous page address, raw request bodies

report_redaction_off.message: REDACTION IS OFF. This file holds real identifiers and request bodies.

report_fields_stay.message: The fields themselves stay in place: you can see they were there.

report_coverage_why.message:
There are deliberately no entropy bits here: without a distribution across
  all users they do not exist, and this instrument runs on one machine.

report_source_unknown.message: source not determined — observed from the network only

report_health_reconcile.message: Reconciliation: $1 confirmed, $2 past the instrument, $3 never reached the network, $4 not checkable

report_warn_killswitch.message: WARNING: the instrument reduced detail under load.

report_warn_budget.message: WARNING: the detail budget is spent.

report_limit_no_block.message: The instrument observes, it does not protect. It blocked nothing.

report_limit_workers.message: Workers are not observed: a fingerprint taken inside a worker is invisible.

report_limit_extensions.message:
Other browser extensions replace the same APIs; their calls are marked
  “not the site”, but the instrument cannot tell their own initiative from
  the page asking them.

report_limit_unknown.message: “Source not determined” is an admission of ignorance, not evidence.
